survey: A glass plate of fruit on a wooden table, against a striped wall. The plate is a shallow ellipse, seen slightly from above, sitting flat on the table. The table planks run back toward a vanishing point behind the plate and meet the wall in a level line just behind the plate's back rim. A watermelon wedge stands upright at the back of the plate. Its red face is seen nearly front-on, and a little of its curved rind shows on the right, so it is turned slightly. Green grapes with a stem and leaf are piled at the left rear. Two strawberries sit at the front left, and four blueberries sit at the front centre with their crowns facing up and toward the viewer. Two orange wedges lean together at the right, their cut faces turned toward the camera. All the fruit rests inside the plate's ellipse, and the clear glass lets the front fruit overlap the front rim believably. The camera is low and looks slightly down, and the plate's ellipse, the table planks, the front-on wedge faces and the tops of the round fruit all fit that one view.
